_about: Decision record, written by hand on 2026-11-26 (NOT a program output). match_sim is the re-ID similarity a returning person must reach before lock-on re-locks onto them. It was chosen by Michael by judgment among measured options; no program computes 0.70 and none of the benchmark's own operating points is 0.70. lockon.py reads match_sim from this file and stops if it is missing. Every number below is checked against the evidence files (program outputs, committed byte-exact) by followme/test_reid_evidence.py.
decision: 'Keep 0.70', his answer at 2026-11-21 22:05Z to the cutoff question asked after the 10-29 replay (options 0.75 / keep 0.70 / 0.79 / wait). On 11-22 he asked for a 0.725 run; after the 0.70 / 0.725 / 0.75 rerun and the benchmark rates were shown, the cutoff stayed 0.70.
how_chosen: Judgment, not an argmax. Replay: no wrong re-lock at any cutoff; 0.79 and above lost him for the last ~2.5 min (he came back at 0.779 and was refused). Benchmark: 0.70 passes more strangers per single look (see bench_stranger_pass) than the benchmark's own cutoffs below.

benchmark.from: Drive jarvis_det/reid_bench_v3.json and reid_scores_osnet_x0_25.npz, written by reid_bench_v3.py (Colab, 2026-11-22). Trials: MOT17 train + VisDrone-MOT val, gallery of 5 crops 1 s apart, query 1/3/10 s later, strangers = every other person in the query frame.
